scope: Native decryption and typed import of bounded Nikon Z8 ColorBalance0803 records.

algorithm: Use serial lowbyte forci; XOR four shutter-count bytes for second-tablecj;ck=0x60. Preserve fourplaintext versionbytes. For each remaining byte,cj=(cj+ci*ck)&255,ck=(ck+1)&255,payload^=cj.
source_contract: Little-endian Z8 TIFF/MakerNote. Tag0097 UNDEFINED/count166/version0803; tag001d ASCII decimal serial with one NUL; tag00a7 LONG/count1. Keys must fit uint32; malformed/missing metadata and unsupported versions fail closed.

limits: Native decryption requires the externally supplied pinned lookup table; no vendor runtime or Perl is used by the core.
The transform has no authentication; wrong keys cannot be detected from the plaintext version header.
Other Nikon models,ColorBalance versions,application WB overrides and complete image rendering remain outside this validation.
